source.text_it: Alle basse temperature, il liquido degli ammortizzatori idraulici deve essere miscelato con liquido antigelo

records.localized_text: At low temperatures, hydraulic shock absorber fluid must be mixed with antifreeze.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi favoriscono la stabilità di marcia perché abbassano il baricentro del veicolo

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers improve driving stability because they lower the vehicle's centre of gravity.

source.text_it: Sull’assale che monta ruote gemellate non è necessario montare ammortizzatori

records.localized_text: An axle with twin wheels does not need shock absorbers.

source.text_it: Occorre controllare periodicamente la pressione degli ammortizzatori

records.localized_text: Shock absorber pressure must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: La sostituzione di un ammortizzatore è un’operazione semplice, che può essere svolta da qualunque autista

records.localized_text: Replacing a shock absorber is a simple task that any driver can perform.

source.text_it: Una specifica spia rossa accesa sul cruscotto, segnala che uno o più ammortizzatori sono inefficienti

records.localized_text: A specific red dashboard warning light indicates that one or more shock absorbers are ineffective.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori, se scarichi, non provvedono a smorzare correttamente le oscillazioni delle balestre

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers do not properly damp leaf-spring oscillations.

source.text_it: Il mancato funzionamento della valvola livellatrice delle sospensioni pneumatiche non permette che venga variata la pressione interna in funzione del carico

records.localized_text: Failure of the air suspension levelling valve prevents internal pressure from changing according to load.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori anteriori possono essere rimossi dal veicolo senza comprometterne il livello di sicurezza

records.localized_text: Front shock absorbers can be removed without compromising the vehicle's safety level.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori hanno funzionamento di tipo esclusivamente meccanico

records.localized_text: Shock absorbers operate exclusively mechanically.

source.text_it: Il mancato funzionamento della valvola livellatrice delle sospensioni pneumatiche determina un cattivo funzionamento del motore

records.localized_text: Failure of the air suspension levelling valve causes engine malfunction.

source.text_it: I cunei fermaruota fanno parte della dotazione di sicurezza obbligatoria per autoveicoli e rimorchi di massa complessiva superiore a 3,5 tonnellate

records.localized_text: Wheel chocks are mandatory safety equipment for motor vehicles and trailers with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes.

source.text_it: I cunei fermaruota servono per bloccare le ruote in caso di sosta dei rimorchi isolati di massa superiore a 3,5 tonnellate

records.localized_text: Wheel chocks secure the wheels when uncoupled trailers with a mass over 3.5 tonnes are parked.

source.text_it: I cunei fermaruota devono essere utilizzati, su un veicolo di massa complessiva superiore a 3,5 tonnellate, in caso di sostituzione di una ruota

records.localized_text: On a vehicle with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes, wheel chocks must be used when changing a wheel.

source.text_it: I cunei fermaruota in dotazione devono essere almeno due, a bordo di un veicolo isolato di massa complessiva superiore a 3,5 tonnellate

records.localized_text: An individual vehicle with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes must carry at least two wheel chocks.

source.text_it: Ai fini della sicurezza, un autobus di massa superiore a 3,5 tonnellate deve essere dotato di almeno due cunei fermaruota di idonee dimensioni

records.localized_text: For safety, a bus with a mass over 3.5 tonnes must have at least two suitably sized wheel chocks.

source.text_it: Ai fini della sicurezza, un rimorchio o un semirimorchio, di massa complessiva superiore a 3,5 tonnellate, devono essere dotati di almeno due cunei fermaruota di idonee dimensioni

records.localized_text: For safety, a trailer or semi-trailer with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes must have at least two suitably sized wheel chocks.

source.text_it: Tutti i veicoli di massa a pieno carico superiore a 3,5 tonnellate, devono essere dotati di due cunei atti a impedire che, su strade in pendenza, il veicolo fermo in sosta possa muoversi

records.localized_text: All vehicles with a fully laden mass over 3.5 tonnes must have two chocks to prevent a parked vehicle moving on a slope.

source.text_it: Su un veicolo di massa complessiva superiore a 3,5 tonnellate, ai fini della sicurezza, occorre utilizzare i cunei fermaruota anche durante le operazioni di smontaggio e rimontaggio di una ruota

records.localized_text: For safety, wheel chocks must also be used when removing and refitting a wheel on a vehicle with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes.

source.text_it: Un autoveicolo di massa a pieno carico superiore a 7,5 tonnellate deve essere equipaggiato con dispositivi omologati atti a ridurre la nebulizzazione dell’acqua sollevata dalle ruote in caso di pioggia

records.localized_text: A motor vehicle with a fully laden mass over 7.5 tonnes must have approved devices reducing spray thrown up by the wheels in rain.

source.text_it: I dispositivi paraincastro, ove obbligatori, devono essere posizionati posteriormente, lateralmente e/o anteriormente a seconda della tipologia di carrozzeria

records.localized_text: Underrun protection devices, where compulsory, must be positioned at the rear, sides and/or front depending on body type.

source.text_it: I cunei fermaruota possono essere utilizzati in caso di ingombro della carreggiata al posto del segnale mobile di pericolo

records.localized_text: Wheel chocks may replace the portable warning triangle when the carriageway is obstructed.

source.text_it: A bordo di un veicolo isolato di massa complessiva superiore a 3,5 tonnellate, i cunei fermaruota in dotazione devono essere almeno quattro

records.localized_text: An individual vehicle with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes must carry at least four wheel chocks.

source.text_it: I cunei fermaruota possono essere utilizzati come dispositivo antirapina

records.localized_text: Wheel chocks may be used as an anti-robbery device.

source.text_it: Tutti gli autoveicoli pesanti, se circolanti su autostrada, devono essere dotati di dispositivo paraincastro nella parte anteriore

records.localized_text: All heavy motor vehicles travelling on motorways must have front underrun protection.

rows.text: A hydraulic shock absorber uses a specific fluid in its own circuit; antifreeze is not added as it is to the cooling system.
evidence: https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ — funzionamento idraulico e controllo degli ammortizzatori.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2018/MC-10136632-9999.pdf, Mitsubishi TSB-18-33-001 — la tenuta trattiene l’olio nel cilindro dell’ammortizzatore.

rows.text: A worn shock absorber damps oscillations less effectively: wheel grip and control worsen, rather than improving through a supposed lowering of the centre of gravity.
evidence: https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ — funzionamento idraulico e controllo degli ammortizzatori.

https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/consequences-of-driving-with-worn-shocks-and-struts.html — worn shock absorbers, wheel contact, suspension movement and control; https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/what-causes-shocks-and-struts-to-wear-out.html — damping and tyre contact.

rows.text: Twin wheels do not replace shock absorbers: the suspension still needs to control axle oscillations.
evidence: https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ — funzionamento idraulico e controllo degli ammortizzatori.

https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/consequences-of-driving-with-worn-shocks-and-struts.html — worn shock absorbers, wheel contact, suspension movement and control; https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/what-causes-shocks-and-struts-to-wear-out.html — damping and tyre contact.

rows.text: Routine inspection checks the condition and effectiveness of shock absorbers and any leaks, not a pressure to be checked periodically like tyre pressure.
evidence: https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ — funzionamento idraulico e controllo degli ammortizzatori.
https://exhibitorsearch.messefrankfurt.com/images/original/mics/10000007202201/0052368684/1649253788079_catalogo_full_bs.pdf, istruzioni MSA Damper — perdite e danni come segni di usura.

rows.text: Replacement requires skill and appropriate procedures; it is not a simple job for just any driver.
evidence: https://aftermarket.zf.com/it/portale-aftermarket/hub-della-conoscenza/sostituzione-degli-ammortizzatori/ — operazioni e precauzioni per la sostituzione.

rows.text: There is no universal red warning light identifying one or more ineffective shock absorbers. Their condition requires an appropriate inspection.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/consequences-of-driving-with-worn-shocks-and-struts.html — worn shock absorbers, wheel contact, suspension movement and control; https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/what-causes-shocks-and-struts-to-wear-out.html — damping and tyre contact.
https://www.eurorepar.com/IT-it/p/1246/La-nostra-gamma/Sospensioni-direzione/Ammortizzatori — usura progressiva e verifica di perdite e rotture.

rows.text: A shock absorber damps suspension oscillations. When worn, it cannot properly damp the movement of the leaf springs.
evidence: https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ — funzionamento idraulico e controllo degli ammortizzatori.

https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/consequences-of-driving-with-worn-shocks-and-struts.html — worn shock absorbers, wheel contact, suspension movement and control; https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/what-causes-shocks-and-struts-to-wear-out.html — damping and tyre contact.

rows.text: The levelling valve adds or releases air from the bellows as the load changes to maintain ride height. If it fails, this pressure adjustment is lost.
evidence: https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf, sezione 6, Levelling Valve 464 006 — regolazione della pressione dei soffietti in funzione del carico.
https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102173.pdf, § 7.2.1 — immissione e scarico dell’aria al variare del carico.

rows.text: Front shock absorbers help keep the wheels in contact with the road; removing them compromises vehicle control.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/consequences-of-driving-with-worn-shocks-and-struts.html — worn shock absorbers, wheel contact, suspension movement and control; https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/what-causes-shocks-and-struts-to-wear-out.html — damping and tyre contact.

rows.text: They are not exclusively mechanical: in hydraulic shock absorbers, fluid passes through valves that resist movement.
evidence: https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ — funzionamento idraulico e controllo degli ammortizzatori.

rows.text: The levelling valve regulates suspension air and chassis height, not engine operation.
evidence: https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf, sezione 6, Levelling Valve 464 006 — regolazione della pressione dei soffietti in funzione del carico.

rows.text: Inspector teaching specifies two chocks for autoveicoli, such as trucks and buses, and trailers over 3.5 tonnes; they help prevent wheel movement. Article 353 governs their use on steep slopes.
evidence: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2025-12/Allegato%20decreto%20520%20DD%20quiz.pdf, quesiti per ispettori di revisione — due cunei per autoveicoli e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.

DPR 495 art. 353 concerns use on steep slopes, not count.

rows.text: A chock placed against a wheel resists movement of a parked trailer, including when detached from the towing vehicle.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/WORKPLACETRANSPORT/sitebased.htm — i cunei contrastano il movimento delle ruote.

rows.text: During a wheel change, chocks keep the other wheels from moving while the vehicle is raised.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/agriculture/topics/maintenance-2.htm, Vehicle repair e Wheel changing — bloccare le ruote durante le riparazioni.

rows.text: Inspector teaching specifies two chocks for a single vehicle over 3.5 tonnes. They help prevent wheel movement when parked.
evidence: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2025-12/Allegato%20decreto%20520%20DD%20quiz.pdf, quesiti per ispettori di revisione — due cunei per autoveicoli e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.

https://www.provincia.tn.it/content/download/5130/51394/file/quiz%2Bmod.%2Bc.pdf — official inspector teaching quiz C2A306 and C2A309, two chocks for stated vehicles; educational answer key, not proof of an unconditional statutory carriage requirement. DPR 495 art. 353 concerns use on steep slopes, not count.

rows.text: Heavy-vehicle teaching specifies two suitable chocks for a bus over 3.5 tonnes, helping keep it stationary.
evidence: https://formartmarche.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Modalita-di-trasporto-mediante-autobus.pdf, § 5801.1–5801.2.1 — almeno due cunei per autobus e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.

https://www.provincia.livorno.it/documents/35271/0/Regolamento_di_esecuzione_e_di_attuazione_del_codice_della_strada_.pdf/8fdae09a-7c9b-e8ac-5742-f8592ba6f4f6?t=1618303798318, DPR 495/1992 art. 353 — cunei sulle strade a forte pendenza per veicoli oltre 3,5 t.

https://www.provincia.tn.it/content/download/5130/51394/file/quiz%2Bmod.%2Bc.pdf — official inspector teaching quiz C2A306 and C2A309, two chocks for stated vehicles; educational answer key, not proof of an unconditional statutory carriage requirement. DPR 495 art. 353 concerns use on steep slopes, not count.

rows.text: Inspector teaching specifies two chocks for trailers and semi-trailers over 3.5 tonnes; they help prevent movement when parked.
evidence: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2025-12/Allegato%20decreto%20520%20DD%20quiz.pdf, quesiti per ispettori di revisione — due cunei per autoveicoli e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.
https://formartmarche.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Modalita-di-trasporto-mediante-autobus.pdf, § 5801.1–5801.2.1 — almeno due cunei per autobus e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.

https://www.provincia.tn.it/content/download/5130/51394/file/quiz%2Bmod.%2Bc.pdf — official inspector teaching quiz C2A306 and C2A309, two chocks for stated vehicles; educational answer key, not proof of an unconditional statutory carriage requirement. DPR 495 art. 353 concerns use on steep slopes, not count.

rows.text: Chocks resist movement of a stationary vehicle. On steep roads, vehicles over 3.5 tonnes must use them.
evidence: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2025-12/Allegato%20decreto%20520%20DD%20quiz.pdf, quesiti per ispettori di revisione — due cunei per autoveicoli e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.

https://www.provincia.livorno.it/documents/35271/0/Regolamento_di_esecuzione_e_di_attuazione_del_codice_della_strada_.pdf/8fdae09a-7c9b-e8ac-5742-f8592ba6f4f6?t=1618303798318, DPR 495/1992 art. 353 — cunei sulle strade a forte pendenza per veicoli oltre 3,5 t.

rows.text: During removal and refitting, chocking the other wheels helps prevent the raised vehicle from moving.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/agriculture/topics/maintenance-2.htm, Vehicle repair e Wheel changing — bloccare le ruote durante le riparazioni.

rows.text: The devices reduce water spray thrown up by the wheels. The quiz marks VERO, but Article 72(2-ter) covers goods-authorised motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers over 7.5 tonnes, new and registered in Italy from 1 January 2007. The question says only “motor vehicle” and is therefore broader; check the category and applicable rules.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-72/ — comma 2-ter, goods-authorised motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers over 7.5 t; new vehicles registered in Italy from 1 January 2007.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02021R0535-20240411 — Annex VIII part 2, 4.1–4.2, type approval categories and exclusions; these are distinct from the Italian in-service rule.

rows.text: Underrun protection reduces the risk of another road user going under the vehicle. Guards may be rear, side or front, according to the requirements for the vehicle type.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2012/73/oj/eng, punti 1–2 — protezione laterale delle categorie N2, N3, O3 e O4 e relative esclusioni.

rows.text: Chocks prevent vehicle movement; the portable warning sign alerts other road users to a vehicle stopped on the carriageway when required.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/WORKPLACETRANSPORT/sitebased.htm — i cunei contrastano il movimento delle ruote.
https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627, art. 162 — segnalazione del veicolo fermo e uso del segnale mobile di pericolo.

rows.text: Inspector teaching specifies two chocks for a single vehicle over 3.5 tonnes, rather than four.
evidence: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2025-12/Allegato%20decreto%20520%20DD%20quiz.pdf, quesiti per ispettori di revisione — due cunei per autoveicoli e rimorchi oltre 3,5 t.

https://www.provincia.tn.it/content/download/5130/51394/file/quiz%2Bmod.%2Bc.pdf — official inspector teaching quiz C2A306 and C2A309, two chocks for stated vehicles; educational answer key, not proof of an unconditional statutory carriage requirement. DPR 495 art. 353 concerns use on steep slopes, not count.

rows.text: A chock prevents accidental wheel movement; it is not an anti-robbery device.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/WORKPLACETRANSPORT/sitebased.htm — i cunei contrastano il movimento delle ruote.

rows.text: Front protection requirements depend on the vehicle category and any exemptions, not simply on motorway use. They do not apply to every heavy autoveicolo without distinction.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2002/93(2)/oj/eng, punti 1.1–1.3 e 2 — protezione anteriore per categorie N2/N3, con esclusioni; scopo antincastro.

reviewer_evidence: All source statements and all 25 learner explanations in four languages checked. ACI https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-72/ art.72(2-ter) directly confirms 30712 goods-authorised vehicles and trailers over 7.5 tonnes, new and registered in Italy from 1 January 2007; answer visibly qualifies broader quiz statement.

Official inspector training bank https://www.provincia.tn.it/content/download/5130/51394/file/quiz%2Bmod.%2Bc.pdf indexed primary table C2A306 V expressly teaches two chocks for autoveicoli and trailers above 3.5 t; C2A309 V discusses presence for inspection. This is official training material, not direct proof of an unconditional statutory carriage provision. ASAPS /tmp/rotonda-asaps-heavy-vehicle-chocks.txt lines 170–187 addresses use on steep slopes. Formart cited PDF returned 403; indexed extract only.

HSE https://www.hse.gov.uk/agriculture/topics/maintenance-2.htm directly advises wheel chocks for repair and wheel changes. Magneti Marelli https://www.magnetimarelli-campus.com/news/nuova-gamma-ammortizzatori/2611/ directly describes hydraulic shock absorbers; Monroe URL returned 404. WABCO motor-vehicle/suspension text https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf indexed levelling valve section inspected; exact second WABCO catalog exceeds browser size.

Rechecked all four revised chock explanations: counts attributed to inspector/educational teaching, with art.353 steep-slope use distinguished; provincial inspector bank C2A306/C2A309 verified independently via indexed primary text. Inspected replacement Monroe https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/consequences-of-driving-with-worn-shocks-and-struts.html, which discusses tyre-road contact and degraded control, and https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/what-causes-shocks-and-struts-to-wear-out.html. Other rows unchanged from full review.

issues.reason: Il quesito dichiara VERO l’obbligo per un autoveicolo oltre 7,5 t senza specificarne la categoria o eventuali esclusioni. Il regolamento verificato disciplina il sistema antinebulizzazione per categorie N e O ed esclude, tra gli altri, i fuoristrada; non stabilisce tale obbligo indistintamente per tutti gli autoveicoli, categoria che comprende anche autobus. Occorre accertare la portata intesa e la normativa applicabile prima di conciliare il testo con il verdetto.
checked_sources: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A02021R0535-20240411, allegato VIII, parte 2, punti 4.1–4.2 — categorie N e O, esclusione fuoristrada e ulteriori eccezioni per dispositivi; la soglia da sola non stabilisce un obbligo universale.
